subject.title: [Bug]: ACP config triggers gateway restart loop — acpx fails to load after self-triggered restart

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102212 be the canonical landing path for this issue, or should maintainers replace it with a consolidated branch that also covers the related fresh-start activation gap?
rationale: The central bug has a live candidate PR with proof, so automation should not open another fix PR, but a maintainer still needs to choose the landing branch and cluster boundary.

options.title: Land the open candidate PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102212 for the restart-loop fix, then close this issue after merge while leaving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102221 for any separate fresh-start gap.

options.title: Consolidate before landing
options.body: Ask for one branch that preserves the hot-reload fix and adds fresh-start acpx activation coverage before closing either issue.

recommendation.title: Land the open candidate PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102212 for the restart-loop fix, then close this issue after merge while leaving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102221 for any separate fresh-start gap.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent gateway/acpx lifecycle history and is the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-boundary merge decision.
